name: qy-player
description: 专为老版本 Linux (Deepin 20.9 / Debian 10, glibc 2.28) 开发的 MPV 内核桌面播放器，支持 Jellyfin/Emby
author: QY Player Team

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:main && npm run build:preload && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder
scripts.dist:all: npm run build:main && npm run build:preload && npm run build:renderer && ELECTRON_BUILDER_BINARIES_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron-builder-binaries/ electron-builder --linux -c.electronDist=node_modules/electron/dist
scripts.dist:deb: npm run build:main && npm run build:preload && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --linux deb -c.electronDist=node_modules/electron/dist
scripts.dist:rpm: npm run build:main && npm run build:preload && npm run build:renderer && ELECTRON_BUILDER_BINARIES_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron-builder-binaries/ electron-builder --linux rpm -c.electronDist=node_modules/electron/dist
scripts.dist:appimage: npm run build:main && npm run build:preload && npm run build:renderer && ELECTRON_BUILDER_BINARIES_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron-builder-binaries/ electron-builder --linux appimage -c.electronDist=node_modules/electron/dist
scripts.dist:pacman: npm run build:main && npm run build:preload && npm run build:renderer && ELECTRON_BUILDER_BINARIES_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron-builder-binaries/ electron-builder --linux pacman -c.electronDist=node_modules/electron/dist
scripts.dist:tar: npm run build:main && npm run build:preload && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --linux tar.gz tar.xz -c.electronDist=node_modules/electron/dist
scripts.test:main: cross-env ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 electron -r ./scripts/electron-node-polyfill.cjs node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run tests/main
scripts.test:render: cross-env ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 electron -r ./scripts/electron-node-polyfill.cjs node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run tests/renderer
scripts.dist:win: npm run typecheck && npm run build:main && npm run build:preload && npm run build:renderer && node scripts/fetch-mpv-win.js && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:mac: npm run typecheck && npm run build:main && npm run build:preload && npm run build:renderer && bash scripts/collect-mpv-mac.sh && electron-builder --mac
